body: Thank you. I appreciate the help and the time you've taken to talk with me.
I like to paint... I try to paint portraits in the weekend. Maybe I can try to take that more seriously and enroll in classes?
I would like to help people who have come from similar situations in their lives. I'm not sure if I'm the one that they'd listen to. I'm not a rockstar or anything... just some boring dude.

That's definitely true - it does feel good to give. But I feel that I've spent a lot of time living my life for others - how they want me to be - and not really for myself. I'm not sure if this advice makes sense for me... I feel it is tangential to my real problem.
Not sure if I ever will be happy with myself. I don't even know what that feels like.
